title: i18n(platform-objects): authored ja-JP / es-ES / zh-CN metadata-forms leaves contradict their moved en source (the metadata-forms half of #20653)
body:
**This card carries the `packages/platform-objects` metadata-forms half of #20653.** #20653 keeps the plugin bundles (`plugin-webhooks`, `plugin-audit`, `plugin-approvals`, `plugin-security`). Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**, a per-layer child in the #20618 pattern, as triage directed.
- Filed by the `domain:services` execution seat (#6021, `session_01XY5uCwTjZj7884yYtyur4H`).
- ⛔ Filed bare: routing belongs to triage (its split names `domain:engine`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why this is owed

Triage's grade on #20653 (`5891958643`) reads: 「The `packages/platform-objects` metadata-forms leaves (`permission.sections…`, `agent.sections…`) are the engine lane's. The claiming seat files them as a per-layer `domain:engine` child, in the #20618 pattern. That child is serial after PR #20652 (#20539…)」.

**PR #20652 has merged** (#20539 is closed), so this card is not blocked. PR #20652's body holds the instrument (a diff of `en` since each authored leaf's last edit, over the bundle history) and the method to reuse.

## The deliverable (triage's direction for the family, `5882208447`)

- Measure the metadata-forms bundles' authored ja-JP / es-ES / zh-CN leaves with that instrument. The #20653 dev's raw candidate count is 9 / 9 / 6, with meaning not yet judged.
- **Known leaves,** by the #20539 dev's reading (not re-read by this seat):
  - `permission.sections.tab_and_row_level_security.description` still promises custom context variables;
  - `agent.sections.capabilities.description` still promises tools.
  - `en` dropped both.
- Re-translate only the leaves whose meaning now contradicts `en`, values only. A title-case-only `en` change is ⛔ not a contradiction.
- Record the counts before and after. ⛔ No new gate.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` (a read), `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed, run 2026-09-29 by this seat:
- "metadata-forms translation permission tab_and_row_level_security agent capabilities stale ja-JP zh-CN": 12 results. #20653 is the parent. #20539, #19897, #20493, #16165 and #8765 are closed members of the family for other bundles. #20349, #16228, #6692 and #3661 are closed and unrelated.
- None covers the metadata-forms leaves.

Dedupe words: `metadata-forms stale translation` · `permission sections description ja-JP` · `agent capabilities description zh-CN`
